records.text: heads up, Granite Labs looks stalled -- no first project after a week

records.subject: Still want to get Granite Labs set up on Wrenfield?
records.body:
Hi Lin,

It looks like setup stalled before the first project. If it would help, I can set up your first project with you so there's less to figure out on your own.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

records.subject: Welcome aboard, Granite Labs
records.body:
Hi Lin,

Great to have you. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, but if you'd rather skip ahead, the important part is just getting real work into it rather than a placeholder.

Reply here with any questions.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no first project, no invite, no key milestone, no tickets, and no reply to the welcome email [email:6e9f9ede]. Zero engagement signal on a Starter plan with 8 days left makes unaided activation unlikely.

draft.subject: Getting Granite Labs' first project going
draft.body:
Hi Lin,

Following up on my welcome note from last week. You haven't created a first project yet, and since projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, that's the one step that makes everything else click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through setting up your first project around real work your team is doing, and answer anything else as it comes up.

Best,
Nadia
